profile.name: Nguyen Manh Dung
profile.title: Backend Software Engineer
profile.location: Tan Phu, Ho Chi Minh City
profile.careerObjective: Aiming to grow into a Senior Backend Engineer / Technical Lead within the next 3 years, specializing in high-concurrency distributed systems built on Go and Node.js/TypeScript. Seeking to own architecture decisions at scale — from data consistency and fault tolerance to service decomposition — while mentoring engineers and driving engineering culture within the team.
profile.summary: Backend Software Engineer with 2.5+ years of experience architecting high-concurrency, event-driven systems using Node.js/TypeScript (NestJS), Go/Gin, and AWS. Led key architectural decisions — newsfeed ranking with Hybrid Fan-out, distributed locking, and monolith-to-microservices migration — for production systems serving 20K+ users at 2,000 req/s peak, cutting API response time from over 1s to under 200ms and reducing database reads by 80% under peak traffic. Built high-throughput Go pipelines processing 1M+ records and multi-GB exports with flat memory usage. Strong fundamentals in concurrency control, system design, and cross-service communication (RabbitMQ, Socket.io, GraphQL).
